The inventor of the World Wide Web did n.why: People write that Tim Berners-Lee invented the Web and that Vint Cerf and Bob Kahn designed TCP/IP, as two separate facts about named people. Nobody writes the negative statement linking them: it is the kind of contrast no one states, since a person is not described by the protocols he did not design. A model names the inventor, then recalls who designed TCP/IP.
